```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

# Read the final analysis dataset
airline <- read.csv(
  "D:/data-portfolio/08_airline_service_performance_visual_analytics/data/processed/airline_performance_analysis.csv"
)

# Keep only network-level records
network <- airline %>%
  filter(Analysis_Level == "Network")

# Overall network performance
total_scheduled <- sum(network$Sectors_Scheduled)
total_flown <- sum(network$Sectors_Flown)
total_cancellations <- sum(network$Cancellations)

departure_otp <- 
  sum(network$Departures_On_Time) / total_flown * 100

arrival_otp <- 
  sum(network$Arrivals_On_Time) / total_flown * 100

cancellation_rate <- 
  total_cancellations / total_scheduled * 100

cat("Total sectors scheduled:", total_scheduled, "\n")
cat("Total sectors flown:", total_flown, "\n")
cat("Weighted departure OTP:", round(departure_otp, 1), "%\n")
cat("Weighted arrival OTP:", round(arrival_otp, 1), "%\n")
cat("Overall cancellation rate:", round(cancellation_rate, 2), "%\n")


# Annual network cancellation rates
annual_network <- network %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Sectors_Scheduled = sum(Sectors_Scheduled),
    Cancellations = sum(Cancellations)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Cancellation_Rate = 
      Cancellations / Sectors_Scheduled * 100
  )

annual_network %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2020, 2021))


# Calculate monthly performance
monthly_network <- network %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP = 
      Departures_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100,
    
    Arrival_OTP = 
      Arrivals_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100,
    
    Cancellation_Rate = 
      Cancellations / Sectors_Scheduled * 100
  )


# Highest monthly cancellation rates
monthly_network %>%
  arrange(desc(Cancellation_Rate)) %>%
  select(
    Month,
    Cancellation_Rate,
    Sectors_Scheduled,
    Cancellations
  ) %>%
  head(5)


# Lowest monthly departure OTP
monthly_network %>%
  arrange(Departure_OTP) %>%
  select(
    Month,
    Departure_OTP,
    Arrival_OTP
  ) %>%
  head(5)
```
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Annual network performance and activity
annual_performance <- network %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Sectors_Scheduled = sum(Sectors_Scheduled),
    Sectors_Flown = sum(Sectors_Flown),
    Departures_On_Time = sum(Departures_On_Time),
    Arrivals_On_Time = sum(Arrivals_On_Time),
    Cancellations = sum(Cancellations)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP =
      Departures_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100,
    
    Arrival_OTP =
      Arrivals_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100,
    
    Cancellation_Rate =
      Cancellations / Sectors_Scheduled * 100
  )

# Show annual performance from 2018 onwards
annual_performance %>%
  filter(Year >= 2018) %>%
  select(
    Year,
    Sectors_Scheduled,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Departure_OTP,
    Arrival_OTP,
    Cancellation_Rate
  )
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4.2 Geographic airport performance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Keep only route-level records
route_data <- airline %>%
  filter(Analysis_Level == "Route")


# Departure airport performance
departure_airport <- route_data %>%
  group_by(Departing_Port) %>%
  summarise(
    Sectors_Flown = sum(Sectors_Flown),
    Departures_On_Time = sum(Departures_On_Time)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP =
      Departures_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100
  )


# Arrival airport performance
arrival_airport <- route_data %>%
  group_by(Arriving_Port) %>%
  summarise(
    Sectors_Flown = sum(Sectors_Flown),
    Arrivals_On_Time = sum(Arrivals_On_Time)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Arrival_OTP =
      Arrivals_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100
  )


# Highest-volume departure airports
departure_airport %>%
  arrange(desc(Sectors_Flown)) %>%
  select(
    Departing_Port,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Departure_OTP
  ) %>%
  head(10)


# Share of sectors flown by the three largest departure airports
top_three_sectors <- departure_airport %>%
  arrange(desc(Sectors_Flown)) %>%
  head(3) %>%
  summarise(
    Sectors_Flown = sum(Sectors_Flown)
  ) %>%
  pull(Sectors_Flown)

all_airport_sectors <- sum(departure_airport$Sectors_Flown)

top_three_share <-
  top_three_sectors / all_airport_sectors * 100

cat(
  "Share of sectors flown by top three departure airports:",
  round(top_three_share, 1),
  "%\n"
)


# Lowest departure OTP
departure_airport %>%
  arrange(Departure_OTP) %>%
  select(
    Departing_Port,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Departure_OTP
  ) %>%
  head(5)


# Highest departure OTP
departure_airport %>%
  arrange(desc(Departure_OTP)) %>%
  select(
    Departing_Port,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Departure_OTP
  ) %>%
  head(5)


# Lowest arrival OTP
arrival_airport %>%
  arrange(Arrival_OTP) %>%
  select(
    Arriving_Port,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Arrival_OTP
  ) %>%
  head(5)


# Highest arrival OTP
arrival_airport %>%
  arrange(desc(Arrival_OTP)) %>%
  select(
    Arriving_Port,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Arrival_OTP
  ) %>%
  head(5)


# Compare departure and arrival OTP for the same airport
airport_comparison <- departure_airport %>%
  rename(
    Airport = Departing_Port,
    Departure_Sectors_Flown = Sectors_Flown
  ) %>%
  select(
    Airport,
    Departure_Sectors_Flown,
    Departure_OTP
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    arrival_airport %>%
      rename(
        Airport = Arriving_Port,
        Arrival_Sectors_Flown = Sectors_Flown
      ) %>%
      select(
        Airport,
        Arrival_Sectors_Flown,
        Arrival_OTP
      ),
    by = "Airport"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    OTP_Gap =
      Arrival_OTP - Departure_OTP
  )


# Largest positive arrival minus departure OTP gaps
airport_comparison %>%
  arrange(desc(OTP_Gap)) %>%
  head(5)


# Largest negative arrival minus departure OTP gaps
airport_comparison %>%
  arrange(OTP_Gap) %>%
  head(5)
```
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4.3 Airport performance across years
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Calculate annual arrival OTP for each airport
airport_year <- route_data %>%
  group_by(Arriving_Port, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Sectors_Flown = sum(Sectors_Flown),
    Arrivals_On_Time = sum(Arrivals_On_Time),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Arrival_OTP =
      Arrivals_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(Year <= 2023)


# Network arrival OTP by year
network_year <- network %>%
  filter(Year <= 2023) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Sectors_Flown = sum(Sectors_Flown),
    Arrivals_On_Time = sum(Arrivals_On_Time),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Arrival_OTP =
      Arrivals_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100
  )


# Show network arrival OTP around the major decline
network_year %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2021, 2022, 2023)) %>%
  select(
    Year,
    Arrival_OTP
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Arrival_OTP = round(Arrival_OTP, 1)
  )


# Compare airport performance between 2021 and 2022
airport_2021 <- airport_year %>%
  filter(Year == 2021) %>%
  select(
    Arriving_Port,
    Arrival_OTP_2021 = Arrival_OTP
  )

airport_2022 <- airport_year %>%
  filter(Year == 2022) %>%
  select(
    Arriving_Port,
    Arrival_OTP_2022 = Arrival_OTP
  )

change_2021_2022 <- airport_2021 %>%
  inner_join(
    airport_2022,
    by = "Arriving_Port"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    OTP_Change =
      Arrival_OTP_2022 - Arrival_OTP_2021
  )


# Number of airports declining from 2021 to 2022
cat(
  "Airports compared between 2021 and 2022:",
  nrow(change_2021_2022),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Airports with lower arrival OTP in 2022:",
  sum(change_2021_2022$OTP_Change < 0),
  "\n"
)


# Largest arrival OTP declines from 2021 to 2022
change_2021_2022 %>%
  arrange(OTP_Change) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  mutate(
    Arrival_OTP_2021 = round(Arrival_OTP_2021, 1),
    Arrival_OTP_2022 = round(Arrival_OTP_2022, 1),
    OTP_Change = round(OTP_Change, 1)
  )


# Compare airport performance between 2022 and 2023
airport_2023 <- airport_year %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) %>%
  select(
    Arriving_Port,
    Arrival_OTP_2023 = Arrival_OTP
  )

change_2022_2023 <- airport_2022 %>%
  inner_join(
    airport_2023,
    by = "Arriving_Port"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    OTP_Change =
      Arrival_OTP_2023 - Arrival_OTP_2022
  )


# Number of airports improving from 2022 to 2023
cat(
  "Airports compared between 2022 and 2023:",
  nrow(change_2022_2023),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Airports with higher arrival OTP in 2023:",
  sum(change_2022_2023$OTP_Change > 0),
  "\n"
)


# Largest recoveries from 2022 to 2023
change_2022_2023 %>%
  arrange(desc(OTP_Change)) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  mutate(
    Arrival_OTP_2022 = round(Arrival_OTP_2022, 1),
    Arrival_OTP_2023 = round(Arrival_OTP_2023, 1),
    OTP_Change = round(OTP_Change, 1)
  )


# Airports that declined while the network improved in 2023
change_2022_2023 %>%
  filter(OTP_Change < 0) %>%
  arrange(OTP_Change) %>%
  mutate(
    Arrival_OTP_2022 = round(Arrival_OTP_2022, 1),
    Arrival_OTP_2023 = round(Arrival_OTP_2023, 1),
    OTP_Change = round(OTP_Change, 1)
  )


# Keep airports with a complete 2010-2023 annual record
complete_airports <- airport_year %>%
  group_by(Arriving_Port) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Year) == 14) %>%
  ungroup()


# Count persistent high and low annual performance
airport_pattern <- complete_airports %>%
  group_by(Arriving_Port) %>%
  summarise(
    Years_Observed = n_distinct(Year),
    Years_Above_85 = sum(Arrival_OTP >= 85),
    Years_Below_80 = sum(Arrival_OTP < 80),
    Mean_Annual_OTP = mean(Arrival_OTP),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Airports most frequently above 85% arrival OTP
airport_pattern %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Years_Above_85),
    desc(Mean_Annual_OTP)
  ) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_Annual_OTP = round(Mean_Annual_OTP, 1)
  )


# Airports most frequently below 80% arrival OTP
airport_pattern %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Years_Below_80),
    Mean_Annual_OTP
  ) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_Annual_OTP = round(Mean_Annual_OTP, 1)
  )
```
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4.4 Monthly performance in 2023
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Network monthly performance in 2023
network_2023 <- network %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP =
      Departures_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100,
    
    Arrival_OTP =
      Arrivals_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100,
    
    Cancellation_Rate =
      Cancellations / Sectors_Scheduled * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(Month_Number)


# Show all network months in 2023
network_2023 %>%
  select(
    Month_Number,
    Month_Name,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Departure_OTP,
    Arrival_OTP,
    Cancellation_Rate
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP = round(Departure_OTP, 1),
    Arrival_OTP = round(Arrival_OTP, 1),
    Cancellation_Rate = round(Cancellation_Rate, 2)
  )


# Calculate monthly arrival OTP for each airport in 2023
airport_month_2023 <- route_data %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) %>%
  group_by(
    Arriving_Port,
    Month_Number,
    Month_Name
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Sectors_Flown = sum(Sectors_Flown),
    Arrivals_On_Time = sum(Arrivals_On_Time),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Arrival_OTP =
      Arrivals_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100
  )


# Count airports below 70% arrival OTP in each month
airport_month_summary <- airport_month_2023 %>%
  group_by(
    Month_Number,
    Month_Name
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Airports_Observed = n(),
    Airports_Below_70 =
      sum(Arrival_OTP < 70),
    Median_Arrival_OTP =
      median(Arrival_OTP),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Month_Number)


airport_month_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Median_Arrival_OTP =
      round(Median_Arrival_OTP, 1)
  )


# Identify the ten highest-volume arrival airports in 2023
top_2023_airports <- airport_month_2023 %>%
  group_by(Arriving_Port) %>%
  summarise(
    Annual_Sectors_Flown =
      sum(Sectors_Flown),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Annual_Sectors_Flown)) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  pull(Arriving_Port)


# Lowest monthly OTP observations among the ten busiest airports
airport_month_2023 %>%
  filter(
    Arriving_Port %in% top_2023_airports
  ) %>%
  arrange(Arrival_OTP) %>%
  select(
    Arriving_Port,
    Month_Name,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Arrival_OTP
  ) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  mutate(
    Arrival_OTP =
      round(Arrival_OTP, 1)
  )
```
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4.5 Route and airline performance in 2023
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Calculate the 2023 network OTP benchmarks
network_2023_benchmark <- network %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) %>%
  summarise(
    Sectors_Flown = sum(Sectors_Flown),
    Departures_On_Time = sum(Departures_On_Time),
    Arrivals_On_Time = sum(Arrivals_On_Time)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP =
      Departures_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100,
    
    Arrival_OTP =
      Arrivals_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100
  )

departure_benchmark <-
  network_2023_benchmark$Departure_OTP

arrival_benchmark <-
  network_2023_benchmark$Arrival_OTP

cat(
  "2023 network departure OTP benchmark:",
  round(departure_benchmark, 1),
  "%\n"
)

cat(
  "2023 network arrival OTP benchmark:",
  round(arrival_benchmark, 1),
  "%\n"
)


# Calculate route performance in 2023
route_2023 <- route_data %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) %>%
  group_by(Route) %>%
  summarise(
    Sectors_Scheduled = sum(Sectors_Scheduled),
    Sectors_Flown = sum(Sectors_Flown),
    Cancellations = sum(Cancellations),
    Departures_On_Time = sum(Departures_On_Time),
    Arrivals_On_Time = sum(Arrivals_On_Time),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP =
      Departures_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100,
    
    Arrival_OTP =
      Arrivals_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100,
    
    Cancellation_Rate =
      Cancellations / Sectors_Scheduled * 100,
    
    OTP_Gap =
      Arrival_OTP - Departure_OTP
  )


# Count routes relative to the 2023 network benchmarks
cat(
  "High departure and high arrival routes:",
  sum(
    route_2023$Departure_OTP >= departure_benchmark &
    route_2023$Arrival_OTP >= arrival_benchmark
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Low departure and low arrival routes:",
  sum(
    route_2023$Departure_OTP < departure_benchmark &
    route_2023$Arrival_OTP < arrival_benchmark
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "High departure and low arrival routes:",
  sum(
    route_2023$Departure_OTP >= departure_benchmark &
    route_2023$Arrival_OTP < arrival_benchmark
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Low departure and high arrival routes:",
  sum(
    route_2023$Departure_OTP < departure_benchmark &
    route_2023$Arrival_OTP >= arrival_benchmark
  ),
  "\n"
)


# Highest-volume routes
route_2023 %>%
  arrange(desc(Sectors_Flown)) %>%
  select(
    Route,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Departure_OTP,
    Arrival_OTP,
    Cancellation_Rate
  ) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP = round(Departure_OTP, 1),
    Arrival_OTP = round(Arrival_OTP, 1),
    Cancellation_Rate = round(Cancellation_Rate, 2)
  )


# Highest cancellation rates
route_2023 %>%
  arrange(desc(Cancellation_Rate)) %>%
  select(
    Route,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Departure_OTP,
    Arrival_OTP,
    Cancellation_Rate
  ) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP = round(Departure_OTP, 1),
    Arrival_OTP = round(Arrival_OTP, 1),
    Cancellation_Rate = round(Cancellation_Rate, 2)
  )


# Largest positive OTP gaps
route_2023 %>%
  arrange(desc(OTP_Gap)) %>%
  select(
    Route,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Departure_OTP,
    Arrival_OTP,
    OTP_Gap
  ) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP = round(Departure_OTP, 1),
    Arrival_OTP = round(Arrival_OTP, 1),
    OTP_Gap = round(OTP_Gap, 1)
  )


# Largest negative OTP gaps
route_2023 %>%
  arrange(OTP_Gap) %>%
  select(
    Route,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Departure_OTP,
    Arrival_OTP,
    OTP_Gap
  ) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP = round(Departure_OTP, 1),
    Arrival_OTP = round(Arrival_OTP, 1),
    OTP_Gap = round(OTP_Gap, 1)
  )


# Calculate airline performance in 2023
airline_2023 <- airline %>%
  filter(
    Analysis_Level == "Airline",
    Year == 2023
  ) %>%
  group_by(Airline) %>%
  summarise(
    Sectors_Scheduled = sum(Sectors_Scheduled),
    Sectors_Flown = sum(Sectors_Flown),
    Cancellations = sum(Cancellations),
    Departures_On_Time = sum(Departures_On_Time),
    Arrivals_On_Time = sum(Arrivals_On_Time),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP =
      Departures_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100,
    
    Arrival_OTP =
      Arrivals_On_Time / Sectors_Flown * 100,
    
    Cancellation_Rate =
      Cancellations / Sectors_Scheduled * 100,
    
    OTP_Gap =
      Arrival_OTP - Departure_OTP
  )


# Compare all airlines
airline_2023 %>%
  arrange(desc(Departure_OTP)) %>%
  select(
    Airline,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Departure_OTP,
    Arrival_OTP,
    Cancellation_Rate,
    OTP_Gap
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Departure_OTP = round(Departure_OTP, 1),
    Arrival_OTP = round(Arrival_OTP, 1),
    Cancellation_Rate = round(Cancellation_Rate, 2),
    OTP_Gap = round(OTP_Gap, 1)
  )
```
